reviews.body: Reviewed the exception flow and regression coverage. The two ordered re-raise branches mirror the synchronous path, preserve both exception identity and attached pipeline/snapshot context, and still wrap unrelated component failures. The tests assert identity for both PipelineRuntimeError and BreakpointException, and the unit/integration matrices are green across Linux, Windows, and macOS. I also checked the failed fuzz job: it crashes in  uzz_filters.py on an invalid Document.metA path and does not exercise the pipeline code changed here; the Vercel failure is authorization-only. I found no blocking issue in this change.
Thanks @pcbeingused333 . Agents no longer produce these errors in 3.x but for consistency with the `run` method I still believe it's good to merge this PR.
